summary.key_finding: Recursive hierarchy counting in kb_list correctly aggregates sub-KB document counts for nested structures. AI-ML-Research(17) and Embodied-AI(9) match perfectly. For 高分子双向拉伸文献库, kb_list doc_count(73) equals the sum of its 12 sub-KB document counts(73), but the root itself reports documentCount=1 in fs_get_tree with no visible .md files—this may be a tree metadata artifact rather than a counting bug.
summary.recommendation: Investigate why 高分子双向拉伸文献库 root reports documentCount=1 in fs_get_tree when children contain only folders and no .md files.
